content.text: {"headline":"Approve no action (P0): service is predicted to hold at 94.2% from 15:00 to 17:00, well above the 80% target, at no extra cost.","why":"General has 27 agents on the phones against 32–34 planned. Absence does not explain the drop: there were only 3 sick calls against a usual 2.4. Volume is on forecast and service level is still 100%. Even with the gap, the disruption window is predicted at 94.2% (payments 91.9%, general 97.6%) with 1.3% abandons. Rest of day is predicted at 94.8%. No intervention is needed to meet target. The cause of the missing agents is still unknown, so check the floor for unplanned breaks, coaching or meetings, or agents moved to other work.","trade_offs":["P1 (IVR callbacks on payments) is also free but predicts exactly the same results as no action, so it adds nothing.","P2 (lending 2 cross-skilled agents to payments) is free but slightly worse overall at 93.8%. It pulls general down to 96.8% and payments still comes out at 91.7%.","P3 (cross-skill moves plus chat deflection) gains only 0.2 points (94.4%) and 0.1 points less abandonment for ₹180, and it borrows agents from general."],"watch":"Keep tracking general headcount. If it falls further below 27, or the floor check does not find the missing agents, re-run the options. Payments is the weaker queue at 91.9%, so watch it first."}
